releaseNotes: Note Lock Forgot PIN now displays a temporary recovery PIN, then opens the new 4-digit PIN and confirmation fields automatically. No extra OK button is needed. Note Lock Off also completes immediately after the correct PIN. Existing notes, photos, PIN data and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Restored the 11:15 AM Note Lock Forgot PIN Copy PIN / Continue flow on the verified 11:00 AM version. The recovery PIN is shown with a Copy PIN button; after successful copying, the popup closes and new PIN setup continues. Other recovery logic and existing app data are preserved.
